_comment: Copy-paste template for module_executor.py MODULE_CONFIG. Shows all supported keys.

_notes.RHOST_values: 'host' = positional, 'target' = URL-form with https://, '-u' = explicit flag
_notes.RPORT_empty: No CLI flag, default port used. Still needs RPORT in module_options.json for console display.
_notes.no_json: Set true if exploit doesn't support --json output. Prevents executor auto-append.
_notes.flag_actions: Boolean flags, no value. Executor appends bare flag if payload matches.
_notes.payload_actions: Flags that take values. For combine values like HOST:PORT, use COMMAND payload instead.
_notes.RPORT_less: If exploit embeds port in URL (no -p flag), use 'RHOST': 'target' and omit RPORT from arg_map.
_notes.https_modules: Add to https_modules list for 'target' style to get https:// prefix.
_notes.ssh_modules: Add to ssh_modules list for 'host' style (bare host, port via -p).
